headline: LeviLauncher v1.5.27
summary: Redesigned the CurseForge interface, fixed Microsoft and Xbox login issues, and simplified storage access and permissions.

items.text: Completely redesigned the CurseForge interface with a cleaner, more compact layout and better usability on smaller screens.
Refactored storage access and permissions management, removing the old storage migration system.
Fixed Microsoft and Xbox login issues
